name: Caverns of Despair
description: Cave system under Arboria in Jamuraa on Dominaria, used by Shauku as a prison for a Cosmic Horror.

description_citations.text: "Caverns of Despair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Falling Star impacts southern Arboria, forming the caverns around the Cosmic Horror.
timeline.quote: The Caverns of Despair formed in ancient times when a Falling Star impacted in southern Arboria

citation.text: "Caverns of Despair", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shauku discovers and enslaves the Cosmic Horror.
timeline.quote: She enslaved the creature and put Aron Legionnaires and kobolds into service guarding it.

citation.text: "Caverns of Despair", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A party of Jedit, Adira, Jasmine and the Circle of Seven frees the Cosmic Horror, which summons a Falling Star to annihilate the caverns; Shauku secretly escapes.
timeline.quote: They freed the Cosmic Horror, which summoned another Falling Star to annihilate the caverns

citation.text: "Caverns of Despair", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
